entities.name: Carlos Escribano Subías
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos Manuel Escribano Subías is a Spanish prelate of the Catholic Church, serving as Archbishop of Zaragoza since 2020. He was previously Bishop of Teruel and Albarracín (2010–2016) and Bishop of Calahorra y La Calzada-Logroño (2016–2020).
